import numpy as np, pandas as pd, requests, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
SEQ=""
avg=dict(G=57.0519,A=71.0788,S=87.0782,P=97.1167,V=99.1326,T=101.1051,C=103.1388,L=113.1594,I=113.1594,
N=114.1038,D=115.0886,Q=128.1307,K=128.1741,E=129.1155,M=131.1926,H=137.1411,F=147.1766,R=156.1875,Y=163.1760,W=186.2132)
mat=SEQ[164:326]; pep=sum(avg[a] for a in mat)+18.0153
HEX,HEXNAC,NEUAC,FUC,SO3 = 162.1424,203.1950,291.2579,146.1430,80.06
glyc = {
 'N267 Hex5HexNAc4 (asialo biantennary)': 5*HEX+4*HEXNAC,
 'N267 Hex5HexNAc4NeuAc2 (disialyl biantennary)': 5*HEX+4*HEXNAC+2*NEUAC,
 'T274 core1 HexHexNAc+NeuAc':  HEX+HEXNAC+NEUAC,
 'S302 core1 HexHexNAc+NeuAc':  HEX+HEXNAC+NEUAC,
 'S303 core1 HexHexNAc+NeuAc':  HEX+HEXNAC+NEUAC}
print(f"Mature chain 165-326: {len(mat)} aa, peptide mass {pep:,.0f} Da")
for k,v in glyc.items(): print(f"  {k:<48} {v:7.0f} Da")
mx = glyc['N267 Hex5HexNAc4NeuAc2 (disialyl biantennary)']+3*glyc['T274 core1 HexHexNAc+NeuAc']
mn = glyc['N267 Hex5HexNAc4 (asialo biantennary)']+1*(HEX+HEXNAC)
print(f"\nGlycan mass, minimal model (1 asialo N-glycan + 1 core-1 O-glycan): {mn:,.0f} Da -> total {pep+mn:,.0f} Da")
print(f"Glycan mass, maximal model (disialyl N-glycan + 3 sialyl core-1): {mx:,.0f} Da -> total {pep+mx:,.0f} Da")
print(f"Observed apparent mass by SDS-PAGE: 29 kDa on HDL (PMID 8093033), 33 kDa on LDL (PMID 9880564)")
print(f"Unexplained gap vs 29 kDa even in maximal glycan model: {29000-(pep+mx):,.0f} Da")
# charge
from collections import Counter
c=Counter(mat); netp = sum(c[a] for a in 'KR')-sum(c[a] for a in 'DE')
print(f"\nMature polypeptide net charge at pH7 (K+R)-(D+E) = {netp}")
for ns,desc in [(1,'1 NeuAc'),(5,'5 NeuAc (max model)')]:
    print(f"  with {desc}: net charge {netp-ns}  ({100*ns/abs(netp):.0f}% increase in net negative charge)")

# --- Eisenberg hydrophobic moment, 18-residue window, 100 deg/residue ---
E=dict(A=0.62,R=-2.53,N=-0.78,D=-0.90,C=0.29,Q=-0.85,E=-0.74,G=0.48,H=-0.40,I=1.38,L=1.06,K=-1.50,
       M=0.64,F=1.19,P=0.12,S=-0.18,T=-0.05,W=0.81,Y=0.26,V=1.08)
def moment(s,w=18,ang=100):
    mu=[];H=[];pos=[]
    for i in range(len(s)-w+1):
        win=s[i:i+w]; th=np.deg2rad(np.arange(w)*ang); h=np.array([E[a] for a in win])
        mu.append(np.hypot((h*np.cos(th)).sum(),(h*np.sin(th)).sum())/w)
        H.append(h.mean()); pos.append(i+w//2+1)
    return np.array(pos),np.array(mu),np.array(H)
p,mu,H = moment(SEQ)
# AlphaFold pLDDT
try:
    af=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q13790-F1-model_v4.pdb",timeout=60).text
    pl={}
    for ln in af.split("\n"):
        if ln.startswith("ATOM") and ln[12:16].strip()=="CA": pl[int(ln[22:26])]=float(ln[60:66])
    plddt=np.array([pl.get(i,np.nan) for i in range(1,327)]); print("\npLDDT fetched, mean mature:", round(np.nanmean(plddt[164:]),1), " mean propeptide:", round(np.nanmean(plddt[35:164]),1))
except Exception as e:
    plddt=np.full(326,np.nan); print("AlphaFold fetch failed:",e)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(3,1,figsize=(13,9),sharex=True)
for a in ax:
    a.axvspan(1,35,color='0.85'); a.axvspan(36,164,color='#ffe9c7'); a.axvspan(165,326,color='#d8ecf7')
ax[0].plot(p,mu,color='#2a6f97'); ax[0].axhline(0.35,ls='--',c='r',lw=1)
ax[0].set_ylabel("Eisenberg $\\mu_H$\n(18 aa, 100$\\degree$)")
ax[0].set_title("Q13790 apolipoprotein F: segments, amphipathicity, AlphaFold confidence and glycosylation sites")
ax[1].plot(p,H,color='#874c62'); ax[1].axhline(0,c='k',lw=0.6); ax[1].set_ylabel("mean hydrophobicity")
ax[2].plot(range(1,327),plddt,color='#2f6b3c'); ax[2].set_ylabel("pLDDT"); ax[2].set_xlabel("residue (precursor numbering)")
ax[2].axhline(70,ls='--',c='grey',lw=1)
for s,lab,col in [(118,'N118',"#c1121f"),(139,'N139',"#c1121f"),(267,'N267',"#c1121f"),
                  (57,'T57','#1b7f5c'),(59,'S59','#1b7f5c'),(274,'T274','#1b7f5c'),
                  (302,'S302','#1b7f5c'),(303,'S303','#1b7f5c'),(164,'R164 RVGR$\\downarrow$','k')]:
    for a in ax: a.axvline(s,color=col,lw=1.1,alpha=.8,ls=':' if col=='#1b7f5c' else '-')
    ax[0].text(s,ax[0].get_ylim()[1]*0.99,lab,rotation=90,fontsize=7,color=col,va='top',ha='right')
ax[0].text(18,0.02,'signal 1-35',fontsize=8); ax[0].text(90,0.02,'propeptide 36-164',fontsize=8)
ax[0].text(230,0.02,'mature chain 165-326',fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print("\nmu_H at glycosites:", {s:round(float(mu[np.argmin(abs(p-s))]),3) for s in [118,139,267,274,302,303]})
print("max mu_H in mature chain:", round(float(mu[(p>=165)].max()),3), "at residue", int(p[(p>=165)][np.argmax(mu[(p>=165)])]))
